# --- SYNTHETIC: InputPlumber was restarted (simulating a hotplug/replug
# event), so the two virtual devices below reappear under NEW event numbers
# (14, 15) instead of their original (8, 9). Everything else about them -
# name, capability bitmap - is unchanged from the real capture. This fixture
# proves find_event_path() re-resolves by NAME after a renumbering, which a
# hardcoded /dev/input/eventN never could.
